description: This file contains the 'Application' class definition in the Opencart admin controller startup namespace, responsible for initializing core components and services during application startup.

classes.name: Application
classes.description: Represents the application startup process, extending the core controller, responsible for setting up essential services like URL handling, customer management, currency, tax, weight, length, and cart services.

methods.name: index
methods.description: Initializes core services and components necessary for the application's operation, including URL, customer, currency, tax, weight, length, cart, and loads validation helpers.
